title: 3D Gait Analysis Using Overground Approach
author: Rachel Senden
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2axqafn

steps.title: Prepare Vicon System
steps.instruction: Set up the Vicon system hardware and software before the subject enters the lab.

substeps.instruction: Configure Vicon system hardware
Calibrate the Vicon system
Zero the force plate
Prepare a database in Nexus 1.8.5

steps.title: Subject Introduction and Preparation
steps.instruction: Introduce the lab and the measurement process to the subject (and parents/guardians if the subject is < 17 years).

substeps.instruction: Ask the subject to change into underwear or tight, non-reflective sportswear
Measure body weight (kg), body height (mm), knee width (mm), and ankle width (mm)
Measure leg length (mm) while the subject is supine, from SIAS to medial malleolus

steps.title: Prepare and Attach EMG Sensors
steps.instruction: Identify muscle locations and attach 16 wireless Trigno TM EMG sensors.

substeps.instruction: Palpate and mark the following muscles on both right and left legs using SENIAM recommendations: m. rectus femoris, m. vastus lateralis, m. semitendinosus, m. biceps femoris (lateral hamstrings), m. gastrocnemius medialis, m. soleus, m. tibia anterior, and m. peroneus longus
Shave and clean the skin with alcohol
Fix 16 EMG sensors to the marked muscles using specific double-sided adhesive tape

steps.title: Verify EMG Signals
steps.instruction: Check EMG muscle activity and record a baseline in Nexus 1.8.5.

substeps.instruction: Verify signals by asking the subject to perform movements such as squatting and standing on tip toe
Record a 30-second rest EMG measurement with the subject lying in a supine position and remaining still

steps.title: Attach Reflective Markers
steps.instruction: Place reflective markers on the subject's skin using double-sided adhesive tape.

substeps.instruction: Provide the subject with standard gymnastic shoes
Attach 16 reflective markers at bony landmarks according to the Plug-In Gait (PiG) lower limb model (excluding the sacrum marker)
Place 4 additional markers at the medial knee condyles and medial malleoli of both legs for functional knee calibration

steps.title: Perform Subject Calibrations
steps.instruction: Initialize the subject model and calibrate joints in Nexus 1.8.5.

substeps.instruction: Insert body weight, body height, leg length, knee width, and ankle width into Nexus 1.8.5
Record an initialization pose for static model initialization
Conduct a static standing calibration: subject stands still in T-pose on the force plate for 5 seconds, feet shoulder-width apart and parallel to the X-axis, arms spread at shoulder height
Perform functional knee calibration for each leg individually: subject flexes and extends the knee approximately 5 times (range 0 to 45° flexion); record in Nexus 1.8.5 and process in Matlab R2016a

steps.title: Conduct Overground Walking Trials
steps.instruction: Collect gait data using the 9-m walkway instrumented with a force plate (1000 Hz, AMTI OR6-7), 10 infrared cameras (100 Hz, Vicon T10S), and two 2D cameras.

substeps.instruction: Instruct subjects to walk at their self-chosen comfortable walking speed along the 9m walkway without targeting the force plates
Collect at least five correct hits on the force plate for both left and right feet
Measure comfortable walking speed using two movement detection portals placed 4 meters apart and centered on the force plate during at least five randomly selected trials
Record all data using Nexus 1.8.5

steps.title: Post-Trial Processing
steps.instruction: Process the recorded data for gait parameter calculation.

substeps.instruction: Perform quality check and step detection (heel strikes and toe-offs) in Nexus 2.7 using foot marker kinematics and force plate data (50N threshold)
Upload raw .c3d files into Matlab R2016a to calculate spatiotemporal parameters (speed, step length, cadence), 3D joint kinematics (angles), and 3D joint kinetics (moments and ground reaction forces)

steps.title: Subject Exit
steps.instruction: Complete the session and dismiss the subject.

substeps.instruction: Remove markers
Allow the subject to get dressed and leave the lab
